SELECT a.`id`, a.`wholesaler_id` AS `wholesalerId`, a.`wholesaler_name` AS `wholesalerName`, a.`CODE` AS `code`, a.`shift_master` AS `shiftMaster`, a.`shift_master_phone` AS `shiftMasterPhone`, a.`shift_master_card` AS `shiftMasterCard`, a.`other_contacts` AS `otherContacts`, COALESCE(b.`num`,0) AS `association`, b.`gearPositionName`, b.`gearPositionArea`, b.`billableTime` FROM `cold_wholesaler` a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT `wholesaler`, COUNT( `gear_position_id` ) num, GROUP_CONCAT( `gear_position_name` ) AS `gearPositionName`, GROUP_CONCAT( `gear_position_area` ) AS `gearPositionArea`, GROUP_CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(`billable_time`,'%Y-%m-%d') ) AS `billableTime` FROM `gear_position` GROUP BY `wholesaler` ) b ON a.`wholesaler_id` = b.`wholesaler`
a.`wholesaler_name` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or a.`shift_master_card` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')

SELECT a.`id`, a.`wholesaler_id` AS `wholesalerId`, a.`wholesaler_name` AS `wholesalerName`, a.`CODE` AS `code`, a.`shift_master` AS `shiftMaster`, a.`shift_master_phone` AS `shiftMasterPhone`, a.`shift_master_card` AS `shiftMasterCard`, a.`other_contacts` AS `otherContacts`, COALESCE(b.`num`,0) AS `association`, b.`gearPositionName`, b.`gearPositionArea`, b.`billableTime` FROM `cold_wholesaler` a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT `wholesaler`, COUNT( `gear_position_id` ) num, listagg( `gear_position_name` ) AS `gearPositionName`, listagg( `gear_position_area` ) AS `gearPositionArea`, listagg( DATE_FORMAT(`billable_time`,'%Y-%m-%d') ) AS `billableTime` FROM `gear_position` GROUP BY `wholesaler` ) b ON a.`wholesaler_id` = b.`wholesaler`
a.`wholesaler_name` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or a.`shift_master_card` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')

SELECT a.`id`, a.`wholesaler_id` AS `wholesalerId`, a.`wholesaler_name` AS `wholesalerName`, a.`CODE` AS `code`, a.`shift_master` AS `shiftMaster`, a.`shift_master_phone` AS `shiftMasterPhone`, a.`shift_master_card` AS `shiftMasterCard`, a.`other_contacts` AS `otherContacts`, COALESCE(b.`num`,0) AS `association`, b.`gearPositionName`, b.`gearPositionArea`, b.`billableTime` FROM `cold_wholesaler` a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT `wholesaler`, COUNT( `gear_position_id` ) `num`, GROUP_CONCAT( `gear_position_name` ) AS `gearPositionName`, GROUP_CONCAT( `gear_position_area` ) AS `gearPositionArea`, GROUP_CONCAT( to_char(`billable_time`,'yyyy-MM-dd') ) AS `billableTime` FROM `gear_position` GROUP BY `wholesaler` ) b ON a.`wholesaler_id` = b.`wholesaler`
a.`wholesaler_name` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or a.`shift_master_card` like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT d.`code` `deviceCode`, c.`code` `code`, c.`shift_master` `shiftMaster`, c.`shift_master_phone` `shiftMasterPhone`, b.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode`, b.`department_id` `departmentId`, b.`department` `department`, b.`gear_position_area_id` `gearPositionAreaId`, b.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea`, a.`unit_traffic` `unitTraffic`, a.`unit_price` `unitPrice`, a.`tenant` `tenant`, a.`cold_water_device` `deviceId`, b.`billable_time` `billableTime`
FROM `device_position` a LEFT JOIN `gear_position` b ON a.`gear_position_id` = b.`gear_position_id` LEFT JOIN `cold_wholesaler` c ON b.`wholesaler` = c.`wholesaler_id` LEFT JOIN `security_device` d ON a.`cold_water_device` = d.`device_id` where b.`billable_time` <= now()

SELECT DISTINCT d.`code` `deviceCode`, c.`code` `code`, c.`shift_master` `shiftMaster`, c.`shift_master_phone` `shiftMasterPhone`, b.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode`, b.`department_id` `departmentId`, b.`department` `department`, b.`gear_position_area_id` `gearPositionAreaId`, b.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea`, a.`unit_traffic` `unitTraffic`, a.`unit_price` `unitPrice`, a.`tenant` `tenant`, a.`cold_water_device` `deviceId`, b.`billable_time` `billableTime`
FROM `device_position` a LEFT JOIN `gear_position` b ON a.`gear_position_id` = b.`gear_position_id` LEFT JOIN `cold_wholesaler` c ON b.`wholesaler` = c.`wholesaler_id` LEFT JOIN `security_device` d ON a.`cold_water_device` = d.`device_id` where d.`code` = #{deviceCode}
